كئب: كَئِبَ 1 , aor. ﹷ, inf. n. كَأْبَةٌ and كَآبَةٌ (S, K) and كَأْبٌ (K) and كَأْبَآءُ; (TA;) and 🡻اكتأب; (S, K;) He was in an evil state, and broken [in spirit] by grief, or mourning; (S, K;) he was in grief, unhappy, sorrowful, or sad. (K.) See also 4.
كئيب: كَئِيبٌ (S, K) and 🡻كَئِبٌ and 🡻مَكْتَئِبٌ (K) A man in an evil state, and broken [in spirit] by grief, or mourning; (S, K;) in grief, unhappy, sorrowful, or sad. (K.) كَئِيبَةٌ and 🡻كَأْبَآءُ the same, as applied to a woman. (S.) === الارض كَئِيبَةُ الوَجْهِ ‡ [The earth, or land, is of sad aspect.] (TA.)
